translation.name: Suha' Maseho: Kadadiam anna Pa'dandiam Bakahu

content: Diona to la mala dituho mendadi to ma'kambi' illaam jumaa'
Iam too inde kada tadibala'i naua: Menna-menna umpemului la mendadi to ma'kambi'
illaam jumaa', tau ia too umpemulu pengkähängam mapia.
To ma'kambi' pahallu la tä' deem nahua pambasa'-basa' penaba, anggam mesa bainena, to la mala ungkuasai kalena, matänä' penaba, to meada', untahima manappa tosabe, manähä umbaba pepa'guhuam,
tä' si umpamäbo' kalena, taia to si bassa' patappaam lima, sapo' la ma'penaba mahamme' anna si umpeä liu kasiolaam, tä' mailu sugali' lako doi'.
La pahallu to palumbängam mapia illaam dapo'na, la napengkahea'i anna napa'kasallei ingganna änä'na.
Aka mesa tau to tä' mapia pallumbäinna illaam dapo'na, la maakam ia susi la ullumbäi anna untähänä' jumaa'na Puang Allataala?
To mane mangngaku tä' mala la dituho mendadi to ma'kambi' illaam jumaa', indana malangka' penabai, nasuhum nahua pa'tahungkungam susi tomahajanna setam.
Pahallu kesanga mapia lako to sulibam. Aka maka' tä' susi, la natula'-tula' tau, napolalam naala pa'pemäläanna tomahajanna setam.
Diona to la mala dituho mendadi to umpamoloi to masussa illaam jumaa'
Susi duka' to si umpamoloi to masussa illaam jumaa'
, pahallu to kesanga mapia, tä' ma'dua tambu', taia to pa'anggur, anna to tä' mailu anna matinna.
Anna sola penaba mahändä la muanda'i liu pepa'guhuam diona lalam kapeimanganna to matappa' to puha napa'paitaam Puang Allataala.
Anna la pahallupi dipetua' manappa yolo pa'palakoanna. Maka' too tä' si'da-sia deem sassainna, iya malam too pole' dituho la mampamoloi illaam jumaa'.
Susi siam duka' lako bainena la pahallu to kesanga mapia, taia to si untula'-tula' solana, to mala ungkuasai kalena anna mala dihannuam illaam ingganna kaha-kaha.
To si mampamoloi illaam jumaa' pahallu la anggam mesa bainena anna to palumbängam mapia illaam pandaposanna anna muäto' manappa änä'na.
Anna maka' nabela umpalako manappa babaanna illaam jumaa', iya la dipa'kasallei anna tuttuam bahanii anna tä' malaja' umpa'patandaam kamatappasanna lako Kristus Yesus.
Jumaa'na Puang Allataala longkahhinna anna andihi matoto'na kamaloloam
Moi anna maelo' siamä' la bale' matim umpellambi'iko, sapo' kupakatu siangko inde suha'

anna mala maka' maela' dä' sule matim, iya la muissammi ma'palako umba susi la pahallunna dipogau' situhu' gau'na änä'na Puang Allataala battu diua umma'na Puang Allataala to tubo. To matappa' iam too mendadi longkahhinna anna andihi matoto'na kaheba kamaloloanna Puang Allataala.
Tä' mala dibahoi maaka susi kamatandeanna pepatuduam diona tubo illaam kamanuhusam lako Puang Allataala susinna:

content.text: anna natappasam Penaba Maseho ingganna pa'palakoanna, naita toi ingganna malaika'.
Dipa'pakahebaam lako tau to tä' muissam Puang Allataala,
dikatappa'i illaam inde lino, anna pangkähhä diäkä' längäm ongeam kamatandeam.

footnotes.text: to ma'kambi': naua illaam basa Indonesia penatua.
to si umpamoloi to masussa illaam jumaa': naua illaam basa Indonesia: diaken battu diua samas.
